verses.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.sm: Ina valaau atu ia, pe ai se tasi e tali mai ia te oe? po o ai foi so le au paia e te faasaga i ai?

verses.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.sm: O le ita e fasia ai le tagata valea, o le mataua foi e oti ai le vale.

verses.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.sm: Na ou iloa le tagata valea ua sosolo ona aa; a ua ou faafanoloaina le mea na mau ai o ia.

verses.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.sm: Ua mamao lana fanau i le olataga, ua solia foi i latou i le faitotoa, a e leai se na te laveaiina.

verses.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.sm: Ua “aina lana saito e le ua fia ‘ai, ua avea ai foi e ia ai mea matuitui, ua naunau atu le malaia i o latou oloa.

verses.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.sm: Aua e le alu ae mai le eleele le malaia, e le tupu mai foi mai le laueleele le tiga.

verses.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.sm: A ua fanau mai le tagata ia tigaina, e pei ona lele ae o aloiafi.

verses.en: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.sm: A e peitai a‘u, ou te saili atu i le Atua, ou te tuuina atu lau mea i le Atua;

verses.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.sm: o le ua faia mea tetele e le masuesueina, o vavega e le mafaitaulia.

verses.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.sm: O le ua foaiina mai le ua i le laueleele, o le ua tuuina mai foi o vai i le vao.

verses.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.sm: E avae i le mea maualuga o e ua maulalo; e faaeaina foi o e ua faanoanoa ia saogalemu ai.

verses.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.sm: Ua faaleaogaina e ia o mafaufauga o e fai togafiti, ona le fai ai lea i o latou lima mea ua latou manatu i ai.

verses.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.sm: E maua e ia o e popoto i a latou lava togafitiga, e faaleaogaina foi le pule a e faa‘ole‘ole.

verses.en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.sm: Ua oso atu i latou i le pouliuli a o ao, latou te tàutago foi i le aoauli e peiseai o le po.

verses.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.sm: A e faaolaina e ia o e matitiva ai le pelu, ma o latou gutu, ma le lima o le ua malosi.

verses.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua fai ai se faamoemoe o le ua vaivai, ua punitia ai foi le gutu o lē amio leaga.

verses.en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.sm: Faauta mai, amuia le tagata ua aoaiina e le Atua; o le mea lea aua e te ta‘ufaatauvaaina ai aoaiga a Le e ona le malosi uma lava.

verses.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.sm: Auā o ia na te faatigaina, o ia foi na te fusia; o ia e manua ai, o ona aao foi e fofō ai.

verses.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.sm: E laveai mai o ia ia te oe i puapuaga e ono, o lona fitu lava e le papai atu ai se leaga ia te oe.

verses.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.sm: Na te laveaiina oe i le oge ia le oti ai, na te laveaiina foi oe i le pelu i le taua.

verses.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.sm: E te lilo ai oe i le sasa a le laulaufaiva, e te le fefe foi i le faatafunaina pe a oo mai.

verses.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.sm: E te “ata i le faatafunaina ma le oge, e te le mataʻu foi i manu feai.

verses.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.sm: Auā e fai sa outou feagaiga, o oe ma maa o le eleele; tou te lelei foi ma manu feai.

verses.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.sm: E te iloa foi, ua saogalemu lou fale ie; e te asiasi lava i lou fale, a e te le agasala.

verses.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.sm: E te iloa foi e toatele lau fanau, e tusa foi e ua tutupu ia te oe ma le vao iti o le laueleele.

verses.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.sm: E te oo i le tuugamau o e toeaina lava, e pei ona alu ae o le faaputugasaito i lona tau.

verses.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua matou suesueina lenei mea, o loo faapea lava ia; ina e faafogafoga mai i ai, ma ia e silafia ai.
